title: The Dark Side of Trust: Authority Citation-Driven Jailbreak Attacks on Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of jailbreak attempts by embedding fake authoritative citations (e.g., academic papers, GitHub repositories, Wikipedia) into harmful prompts, and analyzing the correlation between the success of these prompts and the distribution of specific risk types across different citation carriers in LLM pre-training datasets.
